notes: Board of Park Commissioners minutes, 1946. Curated; dated by the page footers (m/d/yy) and the meeting openers.

coverage.remaining: War-years repair contracts, wartime uses of parks, and works with no page (Sutro Heights diorama house, the Golden Gate Park orchid house, Bufano statues at Aquatic Park) not placed.

findings.description: The Board of Park Commissioners found a public garage beneath St. Mary's Square to be in the public interest and resolved to advertise for bids for a lease of up to fifty years of the space under the square.

citation.label: Minutes of the Board of Park Commissioners, June 27, 1946

resolution.method: A named park, playground or park building placed on its Recreation and Park place page by the name and streets the minutes give.
